selection: Reuse three controls and four pinned first-wave source seeds; 5 semantic instances, 11 first-wave Harbor exports. Remaining tiers stay deferred.
rules: Preserve raw source evidence and exact row identity when materializing.
Keep policy/export validity failures distinct from scored wrong answers.
Pin verifier behavior and record any deliberate change from source semantics.
Do not claim parallel tool execution from a predicted-call batch test.
Model solvability near Snowball scale is unmeasured and not a validity filter for this audit.

selector_conventions.candidate.selector: Semantic source join key or documented fallback from the delegated catalog.
selector_conventions.candidate.fixture_selector: Optional exact JSONL record index and canonical hash for a fixture without a stable ID; null means use the concrete candidate.selector field/value, not that an alternate row was sampled.
selector_conventions.second_wave_candidates: Some have only acquisition/fallback selectors; materialize and pin an unambiguous row before implementation. First-wave seeds have concrete IDs or an exact index/hash.
